Title: MemorySmith.Agent — Testing Infrastructure & Conventions
Content:
The test project (MemorySmith.Agent.Tests) uses NUnit 4.6.1 with standard mocking patterns. **746+ tests** across ~68 test files as of Sprint 59.

## Test Stack

- NUnit 4.6.1, NUnit3TestAdapter 6.2.0, NUnit.Analyzers 4.14.0
- Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk 18.7.0
- coverlet.collector 10.0.1 (for code coverage)
- GitHubActionsTestLogger 3.0.4 (for CI annotations)
- Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Testing 10.0.9 (Sprint 32: ApiKeyMiddleware integration tests)
- Moq or manual mock implementations (MockMemoryGateway, MockWorldAdapter, MockPlanner, FakeTimeProvider)
- NUnit.Analyzers 4.14.0 (Roslyn analyzers for NUnit best practices — catches missing assertions, incorrect test signatures, etc.)
- ci.runsettings activates GitHubActionsTestLogger
- Project references: Agent.Core, Agent.Construction, Agent.Planning, Agent.Tools, WebUI.Blazor

## Test Categories

- **Domain model tests:** WorldState, Position, ItemSpec, Fact, ActionOutcome, world state projection
- **Memory gateway tests:** RestMemoryGateway (via mock HTTP), MockMemoryGateway, KnowledgeResolver, ItemRegistry, SearchResult disambiguation
- **Tool engine tests:** ToolDispatcher routing, InputSchema validation, tool call lifecycle, 14 tool implementations
- **World adapter tests:** MinecraftAdapter, WebSocketBridge, message serialization, event parsing
- **Planner + goal tests:** HtnPlanner, goal type IsComplete/HasFailed, GoalFactory routing, decomposer registration, replan governor, task sequence decomposition
- **Integration tests:** Full pipeline (Connect→Plan→Dispatch→Event→Complete), ReconnectAfterFailures, ApiKeyMiddleware
- **Chat interpreter tests:** ChatInterpreter pattern matching, LlmChatInterpreter JSON parsing + truncation recovery (TryParseTruncatedJson), confidence threshold behavior, IntenManager goal mapping
- **Entity/observation tests (Sprint 55+):** Entity observation, environment queries, Observe→Evaluate loop
- **ExecutionContext tests (Sprint 57+):** Sprint57ExecutionContextTests covering runtime state carry

## Mock Strategy

- MockMemoryGateway: in-memory IMemoryGateway for unit tests (no real MemorySmith instance)
- MockWorldAdapter: simulates WebSocket events for pipeline testing
- MockPlanner: stub IPlanner for agent background service tests
- Test-injectable delays: optional constructor params with null = use defaults pattern for zero-delay test values
- File-scoped test helper classes: file modifier to avoid name collisions
- FakeTimeProvider: injectable time for timeout/reconnect tests
- AgentBackgroundServiceTestHelper: shared helper for agent lifecycle tests

## CI Configuration

- GitHub Actions single build-and-test job on ubuntu-latest
- ci.runsettings activates GitHubActionsTestLogger
- dotnet build --no-restore first
- dotnet test with coverage via coverlet.collector (Cobertura format)
- -p:CopilotSkipCliDownload=true on both build and test to avoid VS Code Copilot CLI download

## Known Issues

- coverlet.collector 6.0.4 doesnt exist on NuGet — use 10.0.1
- XPlat Code Coverage locally shows Unable to find datacollector but tests pass (exit 0)
- Coverage is collected but NOT reported via reportgenerator or uploaded as CI artifacts in Agent repo (unlike MemorySmith main repo which has full pipeline)
- MemorySmith main repo has Validate-Repo.ps1 as unified entry point; Agent repo lacks equivalent
